make.description: The manufacturer or brand of the flowmeter (e.g., Siemens, Yokogawa, Emerson).

model.description: The specific product designation given by the manufacturer, identifying the flowmeter type or version (e.g., SITRANS F M MAG 5100W).

serialNumber.description: A unique identifier assigned by the manufacturer to distinguish an individual flowmeter unit.

flowmeterType.description: The measurement basis or principle of operation of the flowmeter (e.g., turbine).

maximum.description: The highest flow value that the flowmeter is designed to measure accurately.

minimum.description: The lowest flow value that the flowmeter is designed to measure accurately.
